3.6 User Interface and Experience Illustration and 
Rational 
3.6.1 User Flow 
User flow diagrams are critical in designing paths users will follow, during the 
lifecycle of the application. These graphs help visualise the sequence of events 
that will occur during various tasks, with a focus on the user journey. While 
designing the user flow, inefficiencies and barriers can be identified and further 
optimised for the user experience. These diagrams will serve as the foundation 
for the mock UI designed in 3.6.2.
